Hi PG,

MY view is as follows.... Below on the attached picture I believe there is a PAZ which we have engulfed into, now the reason I say engulf is because we have just come out of HTF SD, as per your chart... If there was no HTF level above, I would have classed this as an FO as we did actually engulf higher... Just an idea, why not wait for price to reach this zone and maybe go down to the hourly and look for P.A to tell you whether to short, this will lower risk and heighten the probability.

author: rungodrungo
text: @Vytautas My thought on this is that a reversal pattern must have something to reverse. If you look left you will see that price wasn't trending downward significantly before forming this QM so there's no trend to reverse. Just my two cents.

author: in2forex
text:
Vytautas wrote: Was looking at EURCAD weekly chart, looked like QM, but steped back from monitor and saw some kind diamond in the screen too, so dont know realy what should be more important in this case QM or Diamond, or am i wrong in both cases?

Hi Vytautas

I was looking at your chart and trying to find the diamond, but I can;t see it. I presume you are think the Diamond is the formation in my marked up pink box. To me this isn't a diamond. Can I ask you to re-post your chart and show me where you see the failed QM (Diamond) within the pink box. Then I'll post why I think it isn't a valid diamond formation.

author: Vytautas
text: Hi In2forex, thanks for replay, yes you draw that rectangle at exact place were i thought it was.

author: in2forex
text:
Hi Vytautas

So here's why I wouldn't identify it as a diamond. I could be completely wrong as I'm still trying to get my head around this stuff. My basic understanding of the diamond is we want to see the formation of a possible QM in the PA and then that possible QM fails and price fakes out a second time forming the diamond.

Edit the lower 5 should be 6 on the chart In2forex
